message.text: The s3presign runner was located. Its schedule and server startup wiring will be checked in runner.go and server.go.

The component is `s3presign.Runner` in `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`.

It runs every 12 hours. It is wired into server startup in `server/server.go` at line 129 via `startBackgroundRunners`, which launches it in a goroutine at lines 161–171. I am also checking whether EXTERNAL storage types are handled by a separate mechanism.
Checking whether EXTERNAL storage has a separate refresh mechanism beyond S3 presigning.

The s3presign runner is the only background component responsible for attachment link freshness.

External S3 attachments store raw URLs directly in the Reference field. The memopayload runner may exist but likely is not started in server.go.
Reading the attachment proto to distinguish external storage from S3.

External attachments store URLs directly in Reference fields. They would not need server-side presigning refreshes unless those external URLs themselves expire.

The s3presign runner refreshes presigned S3 URLs in attachment References before expiration. It checks every 12 hours and refreshes URLs that have fewer than 4 days remaining. It is wired into Server.Start() at line 129 via startBackgroundRunners(ctx).

The runner is instantiated and started inside `startBackgroundRunners` at lines 153–174.

The runner also executes once immediately on startup via RunOnce. The exact schedule is every 12 hours, per the comment in runner.go lines 26–27.

The final answer is: s3presign Runner — every 12 hours — server/server.go:129.

h01.

**s3presign `Runner`** (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`) — **every 12 hours** (`runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12` at ```26:27:server/runner/s3presign/runner.go```; it also runs once immediately on startup via `RunOnce`) — **server/server.go:129** (```129:129:server/server.go``` calls `startBackgroundRunners`, which creates the runner and starts it in a goroutine at ```161:171:server/server.go```).

It refreshes S3 attachment `Reference` presigned URLs before they expire: presigned URLs last 5 days (```77:79:internal/storage/s3/s3.go```), and attachments are re-presigned when the stored URL has less than 4 days of validity left (```85:90:server/runner/s3presign/runner.go```). This applies to `AttachmentStorageType_S3` attachments stored outside the local filesystem; `EXTERNAL` attachments keep a static URL in `Reference` and are not handled by this runner.
